purpose: Reference-only catalog for bootstrapping the Digital Twin without inventing patient data.
rules: Reference datasets are never treated as personal observations.
A reference dataset may support anatomy, tissue, cell, or molecular UI, but does not become a user twin by itself.
Missing spatial registration must remain explicit; geometryId, tissueId, and cellId are never inferred from unrelated datasets.
Clinical, health, biological-age, trajectory, and intervention results require an actual validated backend/model result.

datasets.title: 3D Model of An Anatomical Template of Healthy Adult Human Hand
datasets.coordinateSystem: source-defined; retain source coordinates and provenance
limitations: Reference anatomy only; not a personal twin.
Semantic Palm/Thumb/Index/Middle/Ring/Little/Wrist geometry IDs are not asserted by the catalog.
No tissue, cell, molecular, health, biological-age, trajectory, or intervention result is inferred from this asset.
datasets.note: Real anatomical reference. The runtime loads the processed GLB directly from NIH 3D and leaves semantic region mapping empty until source-backed annotations exist.

datasets.title: Bones of the Healthy Adult Human Hand/Wrist
datasets.note: Use for anatomical coordinate/reference context only.

datasets.title: HuBMAP Data Portal / Human Reference Atlas
